options.name: api_auth_cookie
options.description: Authentication cookie for the Checkmk session.

options.name: api_auth_type
options.description: Type of authentication to use.

options.name: api_secret
options.description: The secret to authenticate your automation user. If not set the module will fall back to the environment variable C(CHECKMK_VAR_API_SECRET).

options.name: api_user
options.description: The automation user you want to use. It has to be an 'Automation' user, not a normal one. If not set the module will fall back to the environment variable C(CHECKMK_VAR_API_USER).

options.name: auth_type
options.description: The authentication type. Setting this to C(password) will create a normal user, C(automation) will create an automation user. When omitted on an existing user, the user's current authentication method (including LDAP or SAML) is preserved. Only specify this when you intend to set or change the user's local authentication.

options.name: authorized_sites
options.description: The names of the sites the user is authorized to access.

options.name: client_cert
options.description: Path to the client certificate file for authentication with the web server hosting Checkmk. This is not a Checkmk feature, but one of Ansible and the respective web server.

options.name: client_key
options.description: Path to the client certificate key file for authentication with the web server hosting Checkmk. This is not a Checkmk feature, but one of Ansible and the respective web server.

options.name: contactgroups
options.description: A list of contact groups assigned to the user.

options.name: customer
options.description: For Checkmk Ultimate with multi-tenancy (CME), you need to specify which customer ID this object belongs to.

options.name: disable_login
options.description: If set to C(true), the user cannot log in anymore, but will remain part of the site. Disabling a user does not affect notifications.

options.name: disable_notifications
options.description: Temporarily disable B(all) notifications for this user.

options.name: disable_notifications_timerange
options.description: The duration, for how log notifications should be disabled, if C(disable_notifications) is set to C(true).

options.name: email
options.description: The mail address of the user. Required if the user is a monitoring contact and should receive notifications via mail.

options.name: enforce_password_change
options.description: If set to C(true), the user will be forced to change their password on the next login.

options.name: fallback_contact
options.description: This user will receive fallback notifications. This means, if no notification rules match a certain event, they are sent to the fallback contacts.

options.name: fullname
options.description: A alias or the full name of the user.

options.name: idle_timeout_duration
options.description: The duration in seconds, if C(idle_timeout_option) is set to C(individual).

options.name: idle_timeout_option
options.description: Specify, whether the idle timeout should use the global configuration, use an individual duration or be disabled entirely.

options.name: interface_theme
options.description: The theme of the user interface.

options.name: language
options.description: Configure the language to be used by the user in the user interface. Omitting this will configure the default language.

options.name: main_menu_icons
options.description: This option decides if colored icons should be shown for every entry in the mega menus or only for the headlines (the 'topics').

options.name: name
options.description: The user you want to manage.

options.name: navigation_bar_icons
options.description: This option decides if icons in the navigation bar should show/hide the respective titles.

options.name: pager
options.description: A (mobile) phone number, used to receive e.g., SMS.

options.name: password
options.description: The password or secret for login. Depending on the C(auth_type), this is interpreted as a password or secret.

options.name: roles
options.description: A list of roles assigned to the user.

options.name: server_url
options.description: The base url of your Checkmk server including the protocol but excluding the site. If not set the module will fall back to the environment variable C(CHECKMK_VAR_SERVER_URL).

options.name: show_mode
options.description: This option decides what show mode should be used for unvisited menus. Alternatively, this option can also be used to enforce show more removing the three dots for all menus.

options.name: sidebar_position
options.description: The position of the sidebar.

options.name: site
options.description: The site you want to connect to. This will be appended to the server_url as part of the API request url. If not set the module will fall back to the environment variable C(CHECKMK_VAR_SITE).

options.name: state
options.description: The desired state.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate the SSL certificate of the Checkmk server. If not set the module will fall back to the environment variable C(CHECKMK_VAR_VALIDATE_CERTS).
